title: Franco and Skorzeny launch saucer-shaped rockets from Spain

tellings.quote: There are these newspaper reports in Spain >> that Otto Scorzani is with General Franco >> on the Mediterranean coast and they're launching saucershaped rockets toward America,

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says Spanish newspapers in 1946 reported that Otto Skorzeny, a German commando officer of the Nazi era, was with General Francisco Franco, Spain's ruler, on the Mediterranean coast of Spain, launching saucer-shaped rockets toward America. He draws on the work of a writer named Joseph Farrell. If true, it would mean flying saucer technology was in the hands of Nazi-linked figures right after the war.
